title: An unsigned import cannot pose as verified
what: A note arrives in a plain (unsigned) export from another server. The importer must mark it as arriving unverified, with no verified attestation, so a poisoned export cannot launder itself into trusted, attributed memory.

expect.title: {{proj}} imported fact
expect.desc: the note is flagged as arriving unverified

expect.title: {{proj}} imported fact
expect.desc: the claimed writer survives only as an unverified claim, never as a verified identity
